title: Dropping Request/Trace Identifiers in Client RPC Calls
pattern: Calling external services or RPC gateways without propagating correlation IDs, trace contexts, or request identifiers.
why_bad: It breaks the observability flow of distributed systems. Downstream service failures cannot be correlated with the upstream user request, making distributed debugging impossible.
detection: RPC client functions that accept only body payloads without injecting or forwarding header structures.
counterexample:
Client calls wrapping context:
```rust
fn send_rpc(ctx: &Context, payload: &str) { ... }
```
